compute_mask_iou: compute the IoU between two boolean masks with automatic resizing via bilinear interpolation
compute_mask_iou_batch: compute IoU for a batch of boolean masks returning per-mask IoU scores
compute_sampled_features: compute sampled features from a dataloader by rendering features at query points across images
eval_query_2dseg: evaluate 2D segmentation quality using fixed or ground truth threshold modes on static and dynamic segments
run_eval_2dseg: run the 2D segmentation evaluation pipeline returning static and dynamic mIoU scores with a DataFrame
